findings.passage: “There’s no doubt the 2020 elections had issues, which is why the ACE Act is critical to restoring our election integrity by providing states with important tools to help with the delivery of ballots, verification of signatures, using voter ID, giving observers access to the process, updating voter lists, and conducting post-election audits,” Carl stated.
findings.note: Quoted by Alabama Today (Wayback copy of the article, published 2022-08-16) on his cosponsoring the American Confidence in Elections (ACE) Act. He names voter ID, signature checks, voter-list updates and audits as tools for states.

findings.motion: Cosponsor, American Confidence in Elections (ACE) Act (117th Congress, introduced by Reps. Davis and Steil on 2022-07-27); bill number not confirmed because congress.gov was blocked
findings.note: Alabama Today reports he announced he cosponsored the ACE Act. The article lists its terms as: photo ID to vote in person or to request an absentee ballot; annual list maintenance; a ban on non-citizens voting; states may use REAL ID as proof of citizenship. These terms are as reported by the article, not read from the bill text.
subjects: photo ID to request an absentee ballot

findings.motion: On Passage, H.R. 8281, Safeguard American Voter Eligibility Act (SAVE Act); Carl recorded Aye, roll call 345
findings.note: House vote on a bill requiring documentary proof of citizenship to register to vote in federal elections. Clerk's record lists Carl (AL) as Aye.

findings.motion: On Passage, H.R. 1, For the People Act of 2021; Carl recorded Nay, roll call 62
findings.note: House vote on a broad elections bill that, among other things, set federal rules on voter registration and voting. Clerk's record lists Carl (AL) as Nay. The roll-call page does not describe the bill's ID provisions.
